notes.title: After almost 3 years of making YesterSol solo, there is finally a playable demo!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43332190/2bb7cb09d8b8c626c8852106ef3ff6757ec4d08d.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Hey everyone![/b][/p][p]I’m Nick, a solo dev who’s been learning game development over the last 5 years in my free time. After a lot of late nights and weekends, I just released the [b]demo[/b] for [b]YesterSol[/b]![/p][p][/p][p][b]What’s in the demo?[/b]
• Spear platform traversal & nature seed abilities
• Collect 12 demo shards to unlock a special area
• 2 zones in a hand-crafted world with hidden paths and enemies
• 2 Boss fights to cap it off![/p][p]Any wishlist or review also helps a ton as a solo dev trying to get visibility.[/p][p][b]👉 [/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3939220/YesterSol_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Thanks so much — hope you enjoy exploring it! 🌱[/p]
